name: Hapshuta
overview: Bat El (Batzi) is engaged to Nahorai, they have been together since the annual trip in the 11th grade. After he unexpectedly broke up with her on their Hina, Batzi finds herself single for the first time since high school. The reason for the breakup: she lacks vitality, or ambitions, or work, or in short - simple. Batzi enrolls in communications studies at Savidor Merzac College and becomes a full-fledged student. She breaks out of her shell with her two besties, Timor and Nofer, and together they rent an apartment in Tel Aviv. They also have one roommate, Topaz, who keeps quiet.
